title.zh: M3 Small所有权重叠动态缺口
title.en: M3 Small ownership overlap dynamic gap

intent.zh: 补充专门动态负例，使输入通过范围检查后命中Small所有权重叠拒绝，并验证拒绝后的状态与恢复。
intent.en: Add a dedicated dynamic negative case that passes bounds checks, reaches Small ownership-overlap rejection, and verifies rejection state and recovery.

acceptance: 关联原提交7314929caaf18ed0bca0d0c067c8b669d54e802a与勘误提交4ad691e7dab7948e900845e564be647c01938382，保留原十三条验收和旧记录。

本轮保持proposed；未来仅经独立设计与排程准入转in_progress；真实验证与交付通过前不得verified。
